scope: Source-only and extracted AST synthetic tests. No real raw, report, actual-exit, idle, lock or History read or operation.

findings.finding: Publication guard can skip latest_handoff and active_heavy checks inside the 0.5-second throttle interval.

findings.finding: Self source is skipped at entry and hashed only after computation; receipt can identify a replacement source that was never executed. Only three imported pure sources are checked at entry, with no end check of executed analysis closure/spec/primitive manifest.
findings.fix: Freeze separate analysis self/source closure references before analysis, verify unchanged before publication, and bind original spec/manifest identities without retrofitting analysis into original execution spec.

findings.finding: Repeated capture replaces stored identity when path/hash/bytes match; same-byte file replacement is accepted and final stability check uses the replacement identity.
findings.fix: Keep first-seen identity and reject repeat reference or identity changes.

findings.finding: Empty host checks and nonboolean truthy entries pass the unchanged-host-input predicate.
findings.fix: Require actual call_returned is True, exact bool list of length 2 for alias or 3 for standalone, all True, and no changed captures.
